headline: BNM publishes feedback statement on AI in the financial sector, drawing on 113 respondents
body: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM, the central bank) published a feedback statement on AI in the Malaysian financial sector, following its discussion paper of 5 August 2025. BNM Governor Datuk Seri Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour said in July that more than 70% of Malaysian financial service providers have implemented at least one AI application.
note: Respondents stressed governance, accountability and data management, and BNM welcomed an industry-led AI Model Risk Management Framework that the Chief Risk Officers' Forum is driving.

evidence.text: Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM) has published a feedback statement on AI in the Malaysian financial sector.
The statement follows BNM’s discussion paper of 5 August 2025 and draws on feedback from 113 respondents, as well as wider engagement with industry stakeholders.
BNM Governor Datuk Seri Abdul Rasheed Ghaffour said in July that more than 70% of Malaysian financial service providers have implemented at least one AI application.
They stressed the importance of governance, accountability, data management, talent development and continued industry collaboration.

The central bank welcomed industry-led initiatives that turn emerging risks and practices into practical guidance. One example is the forthcoming AI Model Risk Management Framework from the Asian Institute of Chartered Bankers (AICB).
AICB’s Chief Risk Officers’ Forum (CROs Forum) is driving the framework.
